title: 2003 - The 1st WTIA Awards: J2ME Open 2003
author: hkwtia
plainText: Aimed to encourage development of wireless applications for consumers and enterprises, the contest J2ME Open 2003 was organized by WTIA. Over 300 teams participated the contest.
